_comment: Learning Center quiz (IDEAS 18). Three choices, one right; the explanation names the topic to read. Facts match EDUCATION.md.

questions.q: ABOUT HOW BIG WAS THE ROCK THAT EXPLODED OVER CHELYABINSK IN 2013?
questions.why: ABOUT 18-20 M. IT AIRBURST WITH ROUGHLY 440 KT OF ENERGY; THE SHOCK WAVE BROKE WINDOWS ACROSS THE CITY.

questions.q: WHICH HITS EARTH MORE OFTEN?
questions.why: SMALL ROCKS ARE FAR MORE COMMON: A 20 M ONE EVERY FEW DECADES, A 1 KM ONE ROUGHLY EVERY HALF MILLION YEARS.

questions.q: WHAT IS A RUBBLE-PILE ASTEROID?
a: GRAVEL AND BOULDERS HELD BY WEAK GRAVITY
questions.why: MANY ASTEROIDS ABOVE A FEW HUNDRED METRES ARE LOOSE PILES WITH A LOT OF EMPTY SPACE INSIDE, LIKE BENNU AND RYUGU.

questions.q: WHICH WAY DOES A COMET'S GAS TAIL POINT?
questions.why: THE SOLAR WIND BLOWS THE GAS STRAIGHT AWAY FROM THE SUN; THE DUST TAIL CURVES ALONG THE ORBIT.

questions.q: WHY CAN SOME ASTEROIDS ARRIVE UNSEEN?
a: THEY MOVE TOO FAST TO PHOTOGRAPH
THEY COME FROM THE SUN'S DIRECTION, IN DAYTIME SKY
questions.why: GROUND TELESCOPES CANNOT LOOK NEAR THE SUN. CHELYABINSK CAME FROM THERE; A SUNWARD SENTINEL OR NEO SURVEYOR CLOSES THAT GAP.

questions.q: WHY DO INFRARED TELESCOPES MEASURE ASTEROID SIZE BETTER?
a: HEAT DEPENDS LITTLE ON HOW DARK THE SURFACE IS
questions.why: REFLECTED LIGHT MIXES SIZE WITH ALBEDO; A DARK BIG ROCK AND A BRIGHT SMALL ONE LOOK ALIKE. HEAT GLOW MOSTLY TRACKS SIZE.

questions.q: HOW PRECISELY CAN PLANETARY RADAR MEASURE AN ASTEROID'S DISTANCE?
questions.why: THE ECHO'S TRAVEL TIME GIVES DISTANCE TO METRES AND THE DOPPLER SHIFT GIVES SPEED TO MM/S, PINNING THE ORBIT FAST.

questions.q: WHAT DOES TORINO 0 MEAN?
questions.why: TORINO 0 IS NO HAZARD. EVEN APOPHIS, ONCE A 4, DROPPED TO 0 AS ITS ORBIT WAS PINNED DOWN.

questions.q: AT THE SAME DISTANCE FROM THE SUN, A BODY ON A BIGGER ORBIT IS MOVING...
questions.why: VIS-VIVA: V^2 = MU (2/R - 1/A). A BIGGER A MAKES 1/A SMALLER, SO V IS LARGER AT THE SAME R.

questions.q: DOUBLE AN ORBIT'S SIZE. ITS PERIOD BECOMES ABOUT...
questions.why: KEPLER'S THIRD LAW: T IS PROPORTIONAL TO A^1.5, AND 2^1.5 IS ABOUT 2.83.

questions.q: GRAVITATIONAL FOCUSING MAKES EARTH'S TARGET AREA...
questions.why: EARTH'S GRAVITY BENDS SLOW ROCKS IN, SO THE CAPTURE RADIUS B-CRIT IS LARGER THAN EARTH; SLOWER ROCKS ARE PULLED IN FROM FURTHER.

questions.q: FOR THE SAME STEP SIZE, HOW DOES RK4 COMPARE TO EULER ON AN ORBIT?
questions.why: EULER'S ERROR SHRINKS IN PROPORTION TO THE STEP, RK4'S WITH THE STEP TO THE FOURTH POWER: HALVE THE STEP, 16 TIMES LESS ERROR.

questions.q: THE SAME SMALL PUSH, GIVEN 10 YEARS AHEAD INSTEAD OF 1 YEAR, SHIFTS THE MISS BY ABOUT...
questions.why: THE MISS GROWS ROUGHLY AS 3 DV T: TEN TIMES THE TIME, TEN TIMES THE MISS. EARLY BEATS BIG.

questions.q: WHY IS BETA, THE MOMENTUM MULTIPLIER, BIGGER THAN 1?
a: EJECTA FLYING BACK FROM THE CRATER ADD MOMENTUM
questions.why: THE CRATER'S DEBRIS LEAVES BACKWARD LIKE ROCKET EXHAUST; DART MEASURED BETA AROUND 3.6.

questions.q: BY HOW MUCH DID DART CHANGE THE ORBIT PERIOD OF DIMORPHOS?
questions.why: THE 11 HOUR 55 MINUTE ORBIT SHORTENED BY ABOUT 33 MINUTES, FAR MORE THAN THE SPACECRAFT'S MOMENTUM ALONE.

questions.q: WHAT IS THE RISK OF HITTING A WEAK ROCK TOO HARD?
a: IT BREAKS INTO A CLOUD OF PIECES THAT MAY STILL HIT
questions.why: ABOVE ITS DISRUPTION THRESHOLD Q* THE BODY BREAKS UP; THE FRAGMENTS SPREAD SLOWLY AND SOME CAN STILL FIND EARTH.

questions.q: HOW DOES A NUCLEAR STANDOFF BURST PUSH AN ASTEROID?
a: X-RAYS VAPORISE A THIN SURFACE LAYER THAT BLOWS OFF
questions.why: THERE IS NO AIR FOR A BLAST WAVE. X-RAYS HEAT A SKIN MICRONS TO MILLIMETRES DEEP; ITS BLOW-OFF IS THE PUSH.

questions.q: A GRAVITY TRACTOR PULLS THE ASTEROID WITH...
questions.why: THE CRAFT HOVERS AND ITS MASS ATTRACTS THE ROCK; THRUSTERS HOLD THE GAP. TINY, BUT CONTACT-FREE AND STEADY.

questions.q: IN THE GAME, WHAT MULTIPLIES EVERY METHOD'S EFFECT THE MOST?
questions.why: LEAD TIME. SURVEY PROGRAMS FIND THE NEXT ROCK EARLIER, AND EVERY MM/S BOUGHT EARLY IS WORTH MORE.

questions.q: HOW DOES THE GAME QUOTE A MISS?
a: IN RADII OF MARGIN OUTSIDE THE CAPTURE RING
questions.why: THE MARGIN IS IN PLANET RADII OUTSIDE B-CRIT; NEGATIVE MEANS IT FALLS IN.

questions.q: WHY DOES THE PROJECT KEEP A PYTHON COPY OF THE PHYSICS?
a: TO CHECK THAT TWO INDEPENDENT CODES GIVE THE SAME NUMBERS
questions.why: PYMISS MIRRORS SRC/PHYSICS ONE FUNCTION TO ONE; SHARED TEST VECTORS FAIL THE BUILD IF THE TWO EVER DISAGREE.
